inputs.root_cause: GAP-020: ubl had no implementation-evidence ledger. Its 194 obligations -- the largest register in the program -- had never been classified against source symbols or test selectors.

execution_steps: 1. Read the register: 194 obligations across 18 capabilities.
2. Confirmed the GAP-018 measurement: exactly ONE of ubl's 11 test files imports format_factory.ubl. The other ten import the deprecated ubl.* shadow package and cannot supply selectors.
3. Read that file (test_production_namespace.py, 12 test functions, one parametrized across all 91 document roots) and assigned its tests to capabilities by what they exercise.

4. Six capabilities have no shipped-namespace test at all: UBL-VALUES-001 (19 obligations), UBL-REF-001 (17), UBL-CODELIST-001 (10), UBL-CALC-001 (7), UBL-QUERY-001 (2), UBL-UPGRADE-001 (2) -- 57 obligations. Mapped with empty tests so they are recorded missing WITH a reason rather than omitted.
5. Ran the full suite: 334 passed, no failures, so the declared result is a clean PASS.
6. Built the ledger and ran the proof-requirement audit.

evidence.suite_truth: 334 passed with no failures. As with xliff, that figure is dominated by the ten shadow-package files. The single shipped-namespace file contributes 12 test functions, though one is parametrized across all 91 UBL document roots, so its real assertion count is substantially higher than 12 -- it is the strongest single shipped-namespace file of the four formats examined so far.
